identitySemanticsByLanguage.en: One independent friendly capsule robot with a smooth shell, one inset dark display, two side pods, short rounded arms, two feet and one amber chest light. Preserve the same robot identity, count and placement of these parts, the dark display and amber lamp. The registered appearance option may broaden only the lower torso; the registered colors option may recolor the enamel shell; the selected face and accessory options may change only their named details. No extra characters or unregistered anatomy.
identitySemanticsByLanguage.zh-CN: 单个独立的友好胶囊机器人，具有光滑外壳、一块内嵌深色屏幕、两个侧舱、短圆手臂、两只脚和一盏琥珀胸灯。保持同一机器人身份、部件数量与位置、深色屏幕和琥珀灯。已注册的外观选项只可加宽下躯干，配色选项只可改变釉面外壳颜色；五官与配件选项只改变各自对应细节。不得增加其他角色或未注册的身体部件。

semanticByLanguage.en: a visibly broader rounded torso while keeping the head, screen, side pods and limbs unchanged
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 更宽圆的躯干，头部、屏幕、侧舱和肢体保持不变

semanticByLanguage.en: soft ivory enamel on all shell parts, with the black display and amber chest light unchanged
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 所有外壳部件为柔和象牙白釉面，黑色屏幕与琥珀胸灯不变

semanticByLanguage.en: soft glacier-blue enamel on all shell parts, with the black display and amber chest light unchanged
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 所有外壳部件为柔和冰川蓝釉面，黑色屏幕与琥珀胸灯不变

semanticByLanguage.en: two softly glowing white vertical capsule eyes on the dark display
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 深色屏幕上的两枚柔和发光白色竖胶囊眼

semanticByLanguage.en: two small softly glowing cyan closed-eye arcs on the dark display, a static expression
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 深色屏幕上的两道小巧柔和发光青色闭眼弧线，静态表情

semanticByLanguage.en: a slim muted-teal fabric collar fitted flush around the head-to-torso seam below the head
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 紧贴头部下沿与躯干接缝处的低矮灰青绿色布质衣领

semanticByLanguage.en: one compact mint orb antenna mounted at the top center of the head
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 一枚安装在头顶中央的小巧薄荷色球形天线

rules.colorApplication: Registered image-generated full-body variants only. No runtime tint; dark display, bronze seams and amber chest lamp remain unchanged.
rules.composition: Transparent full-canvas body, seam collar before face overlay, display face and optional top-mounted antenna in explicit source-over order.
